newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz says Q1 premium income higher.
newsitem.headline: Allianz says Q1 premium income higher.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG said its premium income grew in the first three months of this year and that business developments were pleasing.

Deputy board member Helmut Perlet told a news conference that premium growth in the first quarter was up more than 12 percent, taking into account the first time consolidation of Allianz's Vereinte Krankenversicherung unit and currency effects.
Just 1.3 percent came from internal growth, he added.
Perlet said the favourable trend on claims had continued in the first three months.
"Overall it is possible to identify an improvement compared with the year-ago period. Earnings were pleasing and business generally went better," he said.
